raw_sections.projects:
P R O J E C T D E T A I L S
PROJECT 1
NATWEST
Bridges technical teams and business stakeholders to design, implement, payment systems, gateways,
and transactional processes. Key responsibilities include defining payment lifecycles—initiation, authorization, settlement, and reconciliation
Roles and Responsibilities:
Documented all business processes and operating procedures from scratch for an early-stage
startup.
Continuously monitored and evaluated processes to find areas of improvement, ● Researched and presented to stakeholders, obtaining approvals for requirements and changes. ● Creating detailed workflow diagrams for payment initiation, authorization, and settlement ● Developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirement
Specifications (FRS) for new payment products.
Ensuring accuracy in transactions and managing chargebacks, and payment failures ● Facilitating sessions with product owners, developers, and other teams
PROJECT 2
Learning Management Application
Transforming higher education resources into accessible formats that align with today’s teaching and learning needs, ensuring it serves learners from all backgrounds. Delivering the right content at a price that meets institution’s requirements while respecting students’ expectations.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Documented all business processes and operating procedures from the ground up for an early-stage startup.
Collaborated with Product Owners to maintain a healthy backlog. • Led backlog prioritization to ensure alignment with business goals. • Authored clear and actionable user stories. • Gathered requirements from stakeholders and translated them into Epics. • Conducted research and presented findings to stakeholders, securing approvals for requirements and proposed changes.
PROJECT 3
Ticketing Tool The ticketing tool is developed to help the in-house IT Support team. The tool helps the team to track the hardware/software issues within the organization and help the employees work much more efficiently by resolving the reported issues as soon as possible.
Technology: Microsoft PowerApps, Power Automate, SharePoint Online

achieved 96% of deadlines by communicating realistic expectations.
Researched and presented to stakeholders, obtaining approvals for requirements and changes.

The tool helps the team to digitize the entire process of configuration of acts, sections, departments, groups etc., data storage in a structured format, automated approvals, user interface to input compliance details along with signature image upload and analytical reports.

Store the recorded safety observations. ● Designing a SharePoint data store that can store all the details without any errors/issues. ● Generating various invoices. ● Validating the user inputs so that the data is clean at the data store.
PROJECT 6 Training App- Leading Waste management company The application was developed to create training schedules for employees in the organization. The schedules for several types of training such as personal safety can be created and conducted using the app. There is provision for marking attendance also for each schedule. Emails are sent out to the respective people for better coordination among those individuals. Role based access is also implemented within the app, to make sure there is no unrestricted access.
